notes.title: Major Update 0.8.12.3
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone!

Today's update brings two new guns, two new arrogant weapons, a new single player speed-run level, a new map, a new ultimate ability and a new game mode!


[b]Ronin[/b] - Primary weapon
A powerful sword with four different attack types.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/00086b4204f9fde13d4e1f3ab4ee0910fbd83e78.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Vulture[/b] - Primary Weapon
Alt fire Shoots out tracking darts. After opponent is tracked bullets heat seek them.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/39fafd666f3d6235bc4352e30a27eb37334d8057.png"][/img][/p][p][b]New Game Mode: Time Loop[/b]
Things are about to get crazy. Every round your actions are recorded. Every round there is one more version of you! Save your past selves, or destroy the time orbs to permanently remove the past versions of your enemies![/p][p][/p][p][b]New Single Player mission: Time Loop [/b]Prefer single player, but want to get involved in the time mayhem? In this new level you fight YOURSELF! Switch back and forth between assassin and bodyguard. Every time you must be slightly faster, or your past versions will defeat you![/p][p]Unlock the Arrogant version of the Ronin and Vulture by speed-running this level![/p][p][/p][p][b]New Map: Glass Tower[/b]
Want to go fast? Want less things in your way? This map features huge open spaces and bounce pads to send you flying. Be careful though, or you'll fall into the energy pits![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/ffa534907180b7e1eabce67c566d80594d7be19d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Ultimate: Time Breaker[/b]
Activate to give yourself infinite time energy, and see orbs that reveal enemies in the opposite timeline.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bot Improvements:[/b]
In CTF, you can now take the Power Core from your bot by walking up to them.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapon Balances:[/b]

[b]Timesight:[/b] Increased body shot damage by 3, and reduced headshot damage by 1.
[i]The gun felt too inconsistent because of the very low body shot damage. This should resolve that, while also keeping it balanced.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
-Fixed navigation on night map, and on Snow City, so bots properly navigate.
-Fixed some situations where the Timesight would look like it was shooting, when it was not
-Fixed an issue where using the Arrogant Ghost and switching to your pistol would still show the Ghosts over-charge cylinder
-Many others[/p]

notes.title: Small Update 0.8.11.10
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Today we have some bug fixes, weapon changes and bot improvements for you.

[h3]Weapon Balances:[/h3]

[b]Time sight:[/b] +2 headshot damage.

[b]Caster:[/b] -3 damage. Increased recoil when not scoped. Apologies for buffing the caster too much in the last update.

[b]Laser Pistol:[/b] Slightly faster charge up for RMB, and visual recoil to show how close you are to firing.

[b]Viper:[/b] Reduced body damage by 4, resulting in it taking 4 body shots to kill, instead of 3. This will make it much more beneficial to aim for headshots.

[b]Vortex:[/b] Increased headshot damage, so that it breaks enemies shields with 1 headshot.

[h3]Other Changes:[/h3]
Switching Ultimate abilities mid game will reset your ultimate points to zero. This is to counter people only selecting expensive ults when they have enough points for them. This will result in more deliberate choices and use of ultimate's.

Improved bot navigation in CTF. This will result in them being able to return the powercore faster. Changed slightly how they respond to threats when returning with the powercore to make them get distracted less.

Night Survival now displays how many kills you achieved.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed a glitch where throwing the daggers straight down would freeze you in place, or hurl you downwards.
- Fixed a bug where you would get stuck on the forcefields in CTF comp.
- Fixed a bug where Bots would have primary weapons on pistol rounds.
- Fixed a nav mesh issue on Night Survival map.
- Fixed a nav issue in Snow City, where bots could not get to you if you were on the outside of the map.
- Fixed a issue where forcefields were missing from Small Facility in CTF comp.
- Fixed an issue where the Night Survival boss would stop glowing blue, making him harder to spot.

notes.title: Major Update 0.8.11.7
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
Today we have a [b]big[/b] update for you.

[previewyoutube=utD7t9yE0S8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Four new Ultimate Abilities:[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/62e280a547e1ab855f848b952ce44c2ad55d656f.png[/img]
[b]Time Distortion:[/b] Deploy a bubble that freezes projectiles, allowing you to dodge them!
[b]Super Freeze:[/b] Move hundreds of times faster than your opponents!
[b]Dash:[/b] With a single button propel yourself in any direction!
[b]Impulse Lock:[/b] Like moving fast? Save your velocity, hit it again to return to your previous speed!

[h3][b]Quick melee![/b][/h3]
Now you can press [b]F[/b] to punch! Deals more damage the faster you are moving, so get some speed and one tap your friends!

[h3][b]New Playstyle![/b][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/10f3163b23fc5b5eee9bbdba0ea506ebf25710e2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/6709f0d2a02aa6406241f5192c65e288caf99dc0.png[/img][/url]
[b]Vicious:[/b] Track your enemies in the opposite timeline. Red orbs will follow them. Shoot the orbs to damage them and pull them into your timeline!

[h3][b]New navigation system:[/b][/h3]
Our new navigation system allows the bots to use all the movement mechanics, allowing them to jump between roofs, climb buildings and wall run to get around quickly!
Get ready to see bots flying across the sky!
Now they can be a real threat at stealing your power core!

[h3][b]New single player map: Night Survival[/b][/h3]
You came to try to stop the base from being destroyed, but it was a trap!
Survive as long as you can as waves of enemies pursue you, and post your best times on our Discord server! This is also the first single player mission you can jump into with a friend. Put in a password and get them to join, either to help you, or to make surviving a bit more challenging!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/aadb988cfcb66188c02346f6299253b03bcad737.png[/img]

[b]Arrogant Ghost:[/b] [Unlock by surviving more than 120 seconds in Night Survival]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/9fc2d3a857629b5ac3da30532cb06088de83645b.png[/img]

[b]Arrogant Omega:[/b] [Unlock by surviving more than 160 seconds in Night Survival]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/f979c2636f09143005f9e3df0942238191a253ba.png[/img]

[h3][b]Lunar Base Night:[/b][/h3]
You can also play the standard map on night mode now! Turn off your flashlight with L and sneak in the shadows, or pull the lever, shutting off all the lights!

[h3][b]Two New Grenades:[/b][/h3]
[b]Rupture:[/b] Now deploys a one way forcefield that amps damage of outgoing projectiles.
[b]Bounce Dagger:[/b] Deploys a bounce pad to fling you into the air!

[h3][b]Arrogant sword reflects bullets:[/b][/h3]
- Hit alt-fire to go into block mode. It will reflect any lasers, bullets or grenades back to where you are pointing. You cannot run while in block mode.

[h3][b]Time Orbs:[/b][/h3]
The blue orbs that appear when someone time travels now can be shot. If you shoot an orb it will instantly time travel you, using no cyclic energy. This allows for more depth in combat.

[h3][b]Movement Mechanics improved[/b][/h3]
-Backwards wall kicks now have an input buffer, making them much more consistent to land. While crouched hit JUMP right before you hit a wall that you are facing to bounce off of it, reversing your velocity.
-Added in coyote time when finishing wall running or sliding of of objects, to make movement more consistent and responsive.
-Fixed bug where sliding off of objects would sometimes remove your double jump.
-Increased wall running angle limit, so you can more easily attach to walls.

[h3][b]Balances:[/b][/h3]
- Using the Arrogant playstyle reduces your shield by half.
- Caster deals 5 more damage.
- Can charge up Laser Pistol with alt-fire.
- Viper deals 22 more damage per body shot. 30 more damage per headshot.
   Fires hit-scan instead of projectiles, making it more viable long range.
- Arrogant viper deals 8 more damage.
- Paladin deals 26 more damage when scoped. 6 more damage per pellet when not scoped.
  Fire rate 0.6 -> 0.75 seconds. More accurate.
- Arrogant Paladin fires 2 more pellets and deals 12 more damage per pellet.
- Verge gives 8 instead of 9 victory points per kill.
- Ghost's projectile speed increased by 50%
- Nemesis's projectile speed slowed by 30%
- Vortex deals 19 more damage for a body shot, 29 more damage for a headshot.
- Guardian deals 5 more damage.
- Tribent deals 6 less damage, resulting in it not breaking shields with one body shot.
- Timesight now has damage drop off, making it less effective at mid to long range.
- Dusk deals 1.8x more damage and is more accurate.

- Explosive grenade explosion radius reduced from 1100 -> 1000.

- Precise playstyle hacks headshot enemies for 10 seconds instead of 5.

- Made easy bots worse at using Ghost, Timesight and Nemesis.

[h3][b]Improvements:[/b][/h3]
- New scope for the Timesight allows you to see into both timelines simultaneously.
- Comp CTF: Weapons and money reset when switching sides. New UI elements and sounds to make switching sides clear.
- Two new reload animations for the Dusk.
- New reload animation for the Ghost and Verge.
- New reload animation for the Timesight and Laser Pistol.
- New mesh for Timesight.
- New skin for Arrogant Timesight, Vortex and Dusk.
- New scope HUD for Nemesis, Tribent and Scout.
- Command line: Autocomplete with ENTER. Now shows suggested commands while typing. New commands, including setting 1 particular players life/money, and setting points needed for ultimates.
- Made CTF comp spawns different for attacking and defending teams, making it much easier to know what team you are on.
- Made the speed gage actually a round progress bar, instead of a vertical progress bar.

[h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3]
- Can now see teammates outlines while they are invisible.
- Fixed a bug where the bots would think they were stuck while returning the power core.
- Fixed a bug where the bots would get distracted for long periods of time in CTF.
- Fixed a bug where the bots would never loose track of you.
- Fixed a bug with the camera guided rocket being glitchy.
- Fixed a bug where you could reopen the buy menu and change your playstyle.
- Fixed a glitch where two grenades were a different price when you bought and sold them, allowing for money farming.
- Fixed a glitch where the laser pistol's sound always played on the server, no matter where the gun was fired from.
- Fixed a bug where everyone's ping would just display your Steam icon, instead of their icon.
- Fixed a bug with the Tribent's crosshair not reflecting gun inaccuracy.

https://discord.gg/RXrzpYxkt9
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/6afc1f3b2556ea0d1756cd5081b68375a4deebbd.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Game Update 0.8.10.4
notes.notes:
Today's update brings a new single-player mission and more weapons to unlock! But this time it is a little different.
Race to eliminate seven scientists scattered around the city as fast as possible.
This means you can invent your own route! Come up with the best path for the fastest possible time.

But be careful though, there are hoards of guards protecting the scientists!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/861fa016da2f5842570a8a34f38557ff848f8052.jpg[/img]

Unlock 2 new Arrogant weapons by speed running this level! Post your best times on our Discord to earn special roles!

[b]Arrogant Nemesis[/b]:  [Unlock by getting faster than 1:30 time]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/e230c626ab749ec03d024afb217e79cf61caf6ab.png[/img]

[b]Arrogant Paladin[/b]:  [Unlock by getting faster than 2:00 time]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/32e0251c867aa32592182c7915c6e92a53429766.png[/img]

[u][b]Balances:[/b][/u]

[b]Laser Pistol:[/b] Fixed recoil when standing. Now recoil is consistent and no longer extreme.

[b]Explosive grenade:[/b] Has larger explosion radius. The grenade time travels with the player! After throwing it, if you time travel, so will it. This allows you to do some cool trick throws with it.

[b]Paladin:[/b] Damage increased by 12 per laser while not scoped in. Decreased Paladin's price by $200. Created a new run animation for Paladin to make it feel better.

[b]Nemesis:[/b] Fire rate 0.35 -> .38. Increased Nemesis' price by $200.

Laser weapons now can shoot down explosive projectiles too! This makes the Time Sight and Paladin very good at shooting down rockets.

[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]

-Fixed an issue where accuracy would recover slower while time was frozen.
-Fixed an issue where the Omega's projectiles would slightly change trajectory after going through walls, causing inconsistency and making it hard to wall bang.

notes.title: Game Update 0.8.10.3
notes.notes:
[b]Snow City:[/b]
Want something a little bigger? Something where you can move faster for longer? Snow city is more than double the size of Lunar Base. Just don't fall in the pit in the center. It won't end well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/861fa016da2f5842570a8a34f38557ff848f8052.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/3b3be4028e9c997df10f3ca4f8d1b583f05cc668.jpg[/img]

[b]Changes to Competitive CTF:[/b]
-Bought the wrong weapon? Want to buy for your teammates?
You can now reopen the buy menu before the round has started by pressing "B."
-Competitive CTF now has a buy period before each round to plan, buy and strategize!
-Smarter Bots. Bots will take strategic defensive positions, and will be much less predictable.
-All 2 team game modes now show which players are alive at the top of the screen.
-The waypoint now travels around with the power core to make it easier to find.
-Reduced round $ earnings by 300.

[b]New Features:[/b]
-You can now Ping! Spotted an enemy and want to let your teammates know where? Or just want to tell them where you're going? Hit "Z" to ping!
- You can now switch your weapon whenever you want during Warmup by pressing "B" to open the buy menu!

[b]Weapon Balances:[/b]
Omega: Shoots through walls! Has about 2m of penetration, after that the bullet is stopped. Time to wall-bang your friends!

Nemesis: Significantly less recoil. New fire animation. Higher damage.

Titan: Fire rate reduced from 0.35 to 0.6 seconds. Significantly less recoil.

Viper: More accurate. Smaller projectile trails for better visibility.

Caster: Slightly higher damage.

Arrogant Verge: Slightly less explosive damage fall-off.

All explosive projectiles can now be shot out of the sky! This makes all explosive guns slightly worse, as someone could make your grenade explode right in front of your face!

[b]Improvements:[/b]
-Bots now know how to get out of the enclosed spaces in the different maps.
-Bots are slightly smarter.
-Dead players no longer show up as wall hacked
-Fixed a bug where you would respawn with the CTF power core after being killed while carrying it
-Fixed a bug where you could not pick up the CTF power core
-Made bots heads turn visible. They previously would forever be invisible after activating invisibility.

notes.title: Game Update 0.8.10.1
notes.notes:
This update brings a new single player map, 2 new Arrogant weapons, a new game mode, and lots of other improvements!

[b]New single player map: Frozen Moon![/b]
An intense level that tests your movement and combat skills. Speed run it to unlock two new weapons and then post your best times in the official Discord sever!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/7e64fc598af4ce5e359a80f0e19a6cc1741aef8b.png[/img]

[b]Arrogant Caser:[/b] [Unlock by getting less than 120 seconds in Frozen Moon]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/0fd77d3f65a73ff300faab2cdc9afc73b0e5f270.png[/img]

[b]Arrogant Verge:[/b] [Unlock by getting less than 90 seconds in Frozen Moon]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/eb8ff7f679bf66edada2b5eed85bba68c27b3ca2.png[/img]

[b]New game mode: Competitive CTF:[/b]
Teams will take turns attacking and defending.
No respawning until the end of the round, so use good teamwork!
Loose streaks will award more money to the loosing team.

[b]Balances:[/b]
Volatile gives you ALL your grenades back on a kill.
Paladin steals Time Energy from opponents when you shoot them. 
Arrogant weapons now do x2 instead of x3 body damage.
Arrogant Vortex and Timesight give 7 points instead of 8.
Arrogant Dusk gives 11 instead of 12
Arrogant Timesight has double the ammo.
Timesight deals 1 more body damage, and 4 more headshot damage.
Timesight will now scan when you scope up if you are playing Alert.
Shooting enemy with scout will wall hack them for 7 second.
Nemesis damaged increased from 90 -> 100 for headshot damage, and its bullets fly 3x faster, making it viable long range.
Sonar Dagger wallhack opponents for 5 seconds instead of 4.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
Solved the bug with arrogant pistols where you couldn't buy it even if you had enough money sometimes.
Fixed the bug where you'd keep the CTF power core even when you died and respawned.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
Sound plays when you time travel.
Louder sound for invisibility turning on and off.
Time freeze canceled if activator is killed.
Guns with full screen scopes now will fire from your eyes when scoped, avoiding hitting walls right in front of the barrel.
Bots will detect which direction you are shooting them from.
Bots will coordinate where they protect for CTF game modes.
Bots will now have a chance of reacting slower to seeing you if you just time traveled.
In money based game modes, having a loose streak will give you more money.

[b]Command line:[/b]
In the debug menu there is a new command line, with extra options for customizing your game!
Commands so far: (If there is a command you want, please request it)

kick_bots -> kicks all bots in the game
gametime 50 -> set the timer for rounds to 50 seconds
score 300 -> set the score to 300. Default 250 for deathmatch, 3 for CTF 
bot_hardness [0-3] -> set the bots difficulty
AllPlaystyles true/false -> You will always have Swift, vicious and Alert no matter you playstyle 
win_reward x
loose_reward x
loose_streak_reward x -> How much money do you get per round you've lost in a row, after a loose streak starts?
loose_streak_start x -> if 2, you would get a loose streak reward on your second loss in a row.
Bonus money equations: bonus = loose_reward * (losses_in_a_row + 1 - rounds_for_a_loose_streak)
kick_bots -> kicks all bots in the game

notes.title: Patch 0.8.9.12
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Today is a bug fix and balancing patch.

[b]Changes:[/b]
-Verge does less damage: 98 -> 92, 105 hsd -> 99 hsd.
-Verge slightly less accurate.
-Arrogant Viper more accurate.
-Laser pistol now has less recoil.
-Grenade launcher now has less recoil.
-Sword awards 18 points per kill instead of 20.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
-Arrogant weapons now do not lose their skin when turning invisible.
-Sword will not stop swinging if you time travel now.
-Choosing the Arrogant playstyle will no longer sell your pistol in Death Match.
-Auto run is now off by default, so the tutorial makes more sense.
-Time Daggers now do not slow each others disappear speed, meaning they won't stay forever if stacked.
-Invisible walls cannot be jumped off in the tutorial anymore.
-Joining Death Match in the middle will no longer have a chance of you not having infinite money.
-Free grenades now make a sound when you select them in the buy menu.
-Viper points displays properly in Death Match, as 13 instead of 8.

Have a great day!

notes.title: Game Update 0.8.9.11
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Todays update brings a speedrun event!
Jump into the tutorial and come up with brilliant ways to get the shortest time!
Getting a fast time in the tutorial will unlock two new Arrogant weapons as well as earning you special Discord roles to show off your skill!

[b]Arrogant Viper[/b]:  [Unlock by getting faster than 1:30 time on tutorial]

notes.title: Game Update 0.8.9.10
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! This update balances some weapons, has some quality of life improvements as well as bug fixes.

[u][b]Balances:[/b][/u]

[b]Omega:[/b] Increased clip size from 4 to 10 bullets. Gives 8 points per kill instead of 7. Decreased price from $5000 to $4200

[b]Vortex:[/b] 151 headshot damage instead of 149. It will now two tap to the head. This also means the -Arrogant Vortex now one taps to the head.

[b]Scout:[/b] 100% accurate if crouched, even if not scoped

[b]Laser Pistol:[/b] Decreased damage from 44 to 35. Decreased headshot damage from 60 to 50. This is because the Laser Pistol was actually better than the Vortex, even that it is free.

[b]Arrogant Sword:[/b] 12% longer range. Gives 20 points instead of 12, because a sword kill is a sword kill!

[b]Behemoth:[/b] Gives 8 points instead of 7. Having only 1 bullet per clip is a decent disadvantage in Death Match.

[b]All explosive weapons:[/b] Explosions no longer can hit players through walls. Damage will only be dealt if there is line of sight between the explosion and the player.


[u][b]Quality of life improvements:[/b][/u]

[b]Auto Sprint option in Controls Menu:[/b] Tired of hitting SHIFT? This will reverse the controls, so you will walk while holding the sprint button, and otherwise sprint automatically. If you had bound "W" to sprint though, make sure to disable that before enabling this!

[b]Clearer how to send a message:[/b] Made it so that at the end of the game it gives players a prompt to send messages. Should it be easier to see messages during the game? Should they cause a pop up? Let us know!

[b]Notification on Join:[/b] Sends message when a player joins the game.

[b]Better buy menu:[/b] In Death Match, weapons will show their points for a kill, instead of showing their price.

[b]Discord link:[/b] A Discord link to our official server in the main menu! You can get rid of it by clicking it.

[b]Screen Resolution:[/b] Added in 3440x1440 screen resolution option. Want another resolution option? Request it on our Discord!

[b]No player collisions:[/b] Players will no longer bump into each other, killing your precious momentum!



[u][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/u]
-Made it so that you can no longer see LAN games if not on the LAN network.
-Fixed a glitch where the round would restart twice, giving everyone extra money in Last Standing.
-Fixed floating guns when kicking bots.
-Made it so explosion marks don't get attached to players, because that looked weird...

Have an idea? Join our Discord server! Give your feedback!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/6afc1f3b2556ea0d1756cd5081b68375a4deebbd.jpg[/img]
https://discord.gg/nPtYKVCeHc

notes.title: Patch 0.8.9.9
notes.notes:
This is a small bug fix patch that resolves the issues I missed in the last update.

[b]New Features:[/b]
You can now buy a better version of the Ion Sword if you are using the Arrogant Playstyle! It not only has a longer range of attack, but also recharges your time energy very fast while it is equipped, allowing you to dodge between timelines as you approach your enemies.

[b]Improvements:[/b]
-Increased the Laser Pistols damage from 30 to 44
-Made it so that in Last Standing, if all players are dead, the round will immediately end, saying "All bots have won" and all living bots will gain 1 point.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
-Fixed Max km/h stat in Last Standing. It was displaying wrong, always as 144km/h
-Fixed error where you sometimes couldn't capture the flag
-Fixed an error where the Playstyle menu would get stuck on your screen in Last Standing
-Fixed a error where Respawn button sometimes wouldn't respawn you
-Fixed the chat, so that you can now properly send messages even when the game has ended. Time to say gg to everyone!
-Fixed the spectating camera flying around when the person who you were spectating died
-Reduced impulse from being shot by a grenade while living, to reduce the bug where you would sometime get pushed through a wall

Thank you for reading the patch notes! Have a great day!

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! This update brings two new game modes:

[b]Flying Scout:[/b] Test your aim with this fast paced sniper battle! Only Scout rifles and swords. Players have less life and infinite wallhacks for faster rounds!
This is an All V All last standing game mode.

[b]Vortex:[/b] Like killing your opponents fast? This is the game mode for you. All it takes is 2 body shots or one headshot to kill. Only Vortex pistols and swords. It is all about who shoots first in this mode! Test your flicks and test your aim in this last standing game mode!

Have an idea for a new game mode? Let us know!
Join our Official Discord server and give us your feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44858260/6afc1f3b2556ea0d1756cd5081b68375a4deebbd.jpg[/img]
https://discord.gg/nPtYKVCeHc


[b]Quick Video Tutorial:[/b] Want to be able to move faster? I threw together this quick video to show you some advanced movement mechanics!
Crouching allows you to do backwards wall kicks and Source style air-strafing!
https://youtu.be/JE4aJNQmFTc


[b]Other Changes:[/b]

Map Changes
-Fixed visual glitch of snow randomly disappearing if you were looking straight down at it
-Fixed 2 locations in Small Facility where you could get stuck
-Fixed 3 missing collisions in Small Facility
-Improved Bots pathfinding for Small Facility

Weapon Changes
-Made Viper recover from recoil faster
